house.description: Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio (CLUES) funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio (CLUES).

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; COMUNIDADES LATINAS UNIDAS EN SERVICIO (CLUES). +]

[+$750,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $750,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio (CLUES) to expand art-making and programming to celebrate Latino cultural heritage and support local artists with tools, professional development, networking, and gallery and presentation opportunities. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio (CLUES).

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COMUNIDADES LATINAS UNIDAS EN SERVICIO (CLUES).

$750,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $750,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Comunidades Latinas Unidas En Servicio (CLUES) to expand art-making and programming to celebrate Latino cultural heritage and support local artists with tools, professional development, networking, and gallery and presentation opportunities.
